Operating margin improved to eighteen percent as infrastructure costs were brought down through the migration to the new scheduling stack. Headcount grew modestly, concentrated in support and reliability engineering. The board approved a new buyback program and reaffirmed guidance for the next two quarters. Risks called out include foreign-exchange exposure, a competitive pricing environment in the mid-market tier, and ongoing supply constraints for specialized hardware used in the on-premises deployment option. Management expects these pressures to ease in the second half of the fiscal year as new supplier agreements take effect and as the enterprise renewal cohort completes its annual cycle.
